_comment: RAM addresses whose names are supported by evidence. Key: hex address. Each entry: name, note (what the evidence shows), evidence (id in docs/EVIDENCE_LOG.md). Addresses not listed get address names (wXXXX, hXXXX, sXXXX) with no meaning claimed.

C525.name: wIsCGB
C525.note: 1 when the boot code found A = $11 (CGB), else 0; set at $0150

D7FE.name: wDataBank
D7FE.note: ROM bank used by Func_000_0B6C when reading a word through HL

D067.name: wDataBankSave
D067.note: spare slot some code copies wDataBank to and restores it from

DD10.name: wSoundId
DD10.note: sound id passed to the start-sound routine

DC00.name: wSoundChannelSlots
DC00.note: channel-state slots; the record's first byte is added to this address

DCC0.name: wSoundLabelSlots
DCC0.note: per-channel label slots: 3 bytes each, 16 per channel

DD0F.name: wSoundChannelIndex
DD0F.note: slot number of the channel the sound engine is processing

DD0A.name: wSoundHwChannel
DD0A.note: hardware channel of the current slot: 2 selects the wave channel, 3 noise

FFDD.name: hSoundBank
FFDD.note: ROM bank the sound engine reads tracks from

FFD8.name: hTrackPosLo
FFD8.note: low byte of the current track position, counted in 2-byte events

FFD9.name: hTrackPosHi
FFD9.note: high byte of the current track position

FFDB.name: hTrackBaseLo
FFDB.note: low byte of the current track's start address

FFDC.name: hTrackBaseHi
FFDC.note: high byte of the current track's start address

FFD6.name: hDecompressLock
FFD6.note: non-zero while the decompressor is running

FFBB.name: hDecompressMarker
FFBB.note: marker byte from the stream header

FFA1.name: hScrollX
FFA1.note: copied to rSCX by Func_000_07E0 and by the LCD handler

FFA5.name: hScrollY
FFA5.note: copied to rSCY by Func_000_07E0 and by the LCD handler

FFB1.name: hOamNextEntry
FFB1.note: index of the next 4-byte entry BuildOamFromSpriteTable writes at $C000; it stops at $28

C0A2.name: wMenuRowCount
C0A2.note: number of cursor rows UpdateMenuCursor wraps over (E-0060)

C0A3.name: wMenuPageCount
C0A3.note: number of pages UpdateMenuCursor steps through with Left/Right; 0 or 1 disables paging (E-0060)

C0A5.name: wMenuLastPageRows
C0A5.note: rows on the last page; UpdateMenuCursor clamps the row to this minus 1 there (E-0060)

C0A6.name: wMenuPage
C0A6.note: current page index set by UpdateMenuCursor (E-0060)

C53D.name: wStringDestLo
C53D.note: low byte of the destination CopyStringToBuffer writes the string to (E-0059)

C53E.name: wStringDestHi
C53E.note: high byte of the destination CopyStringToBuffer writes the string to (E-0059)

C528.name: wStringCategory
C528.note: category index LookupString uses in the table of tables

C529.name: wStringIndex
C529.note: index within the category table that LookupString uses

C52A.name: wStringBank
C52A.note: ROM bank number LookupString stores; the string printer maps it into the ROM bank window

FFA9.name: hSpriteOriginX
FFA9.note: added to each entry's X (+8) by BuildOamFromSpriteTable

FFAB.name: hSpriteOriginY
FFAB.note: added to each entry's Y (+$10) by BuildOamFromSpriteTable

FFAD.name: hSpriteSetIndex
FFAD.note: first-level index into the table BuildOamFromSpriteTable reads

FFAE.name: hSpriteSubIndex
FFAE.note: second-level index into the table BuildOamFromSpriteTable reads

FFAF.name: hSpriteTileOffset
FFAF.note: added to each entry's tile number by BuildOamFromSpriteTable

FFB0.name: hSpriteAttrXor
FFB0.note: XORed into each entry's attribute byte by BuildOamFromSpriteTable

CB7F.name: wSpriteSlots
CB7F.note: start of an array of objects: 8-byte slots in the bank $E0 intro (DrawSpriteSlots), 16-byte entries in field mode (the script commands, ScriptStepObject)

C198.name: wScreenTileBuffer
C198.note: screen tile buffer: the $240 bytes are cleared with $C3; CopyTileBufferToBGMap and CopyBlockToTileBuffer use rows of 32 bytes, while field mode (Func_002_59CD) indexes it with rows of 20 and 260 of its 360 visible entries equal the BG map on the emulator (E-0030)

C524.name: wSGBActive
C524.note: set to 1 at boot, cleared on CGB and when DetectSGB finds no Super Game Boy; SendSGBPacketSet, DelayBCWhenSGB and SpinDelay return at once when it is 0

C47C.name: wSGBPacketIndex
C47C.note: packet set number for SendSGBPacketSet; $FF selects wSGBPacketBuffer

C47F.name: wSGBPacketBuffer
C47F.note: packet data used by SendSGBPacketSet when wSGBPacketIndex is $FF

C5DB.name: wGameMode
C5DB.note: index into the 9-entry tables RunGameModeInit and RunGameModeUpdate use; 5 at boot

C5DF.name: wModeChangeRequest
C5DF.note: non-zero makes the main loop leave its wait and run RunGameModeInit again

C56C.name: wFadeState
C56C.note: palette fade state set by StartPaletteFade; GameFrameUpdate and the VBlank handler skip normal work while it is non-zero (bit 7 clear)

C55E.name: wJoypadHeld
C55E.note: buttons held at the latest PollJoypad (layout of ReadJoypadDirect)

C562.name: wJoypadPressed
C562.note: buttons newly held since the previous poll

C564.name: wJoypadRepeatTimer
C564.note: auto-repeat countdown: $14 after a new press, then 6

C5F0.name: wFrameCounterLo
C5F0.note: low byte of the 16-bit frame counter the VBlank handler increments

C5F1.name: wFrameCounterHi
C5F1.note: high byte of the 16-bit frame counter

C60A.name: wMusicRequest
C60A.note: music id waiting for ProcessSoundQueue; $FF = none

C60B.name: wSoundEffectRequest
C60B.note: sound effect id waiting for ProcessSoundQueue; $FF = none

C5DC.name: wModeState
C5DC.note: per-mode sub-state; low nibble indexes the jump table in GameMode1_Update (E-0030)

FFA2.name: hScrollXHi
FFA2.note: high byte of the 16-bit horizontal scroll that starts at hScrollX

FFA6.name: hScrollYHi
FFA6.note: high byte of the 16-bit vertical scroll that starts at hScrollY

FFAA.name: hSpriteOriginXHi
FFAA.note: high byte of the 16-bit sprite X position (hSpriteOriginX is the low byte)

FFAC.name: hSpriteOriginYHi
FFAC.note: high byte of the 16-bit sprite Y position (hSpriteOriginY is the low byte)

FFD2.name: hSpriteScrollXLo
FFD2.note: low byte of -(scroll X - 9) - 1, computed each frame by ComputeSpriteScrollOffsets

FF98.name: hPlayerFacing
FF98.note: 0, 1, 2, 3: CheckInteractionInFront adds +16 to hFF91, +16 to hFF8E, -16 to hFF91, -16 to hFF8E for these values

FF8E.name: hPlayerX
FF8E.note: position along the axis that facings 1 and 3 change in CheckInteractionInFront

FF91.name: hPlayerY
FF91.note: position along the axis that facings 0 and 2 change in CheckInteractionInFront

C82D.name: wPlayFrames
C82D.note: frame count 0-59 of the play-time counter

C830.name: wPlayHoursLo
C830.note: low byte of the 16-bit play-time hours

C831.name: wPlayHoursHi
C831.note: high byte of the 16-bit play-time hours

D968.name: wSlotPersonalityHi
D968.note: first of three byte arrays (8 slots each) graded into the personality index with weight 9 by PersonalityIndexOfSlot

D2C7.name: wPersonalityIndex
D2C7.note: column index (0-26) into the bank-6 table; set from PersonalityIndexOfSlot in banks $30 and $E0 before ReadBank6TableWord

CFEC.name: wRecordBuffer
CFEC.note: scratch buffer shared by the record loaders: LoadSkillRecord reads its first word as the skill number and writes 17 bytes after it; LoadMonsterRecord stores a 26-byte monster record here

CFEE.name: wRecordBufferData
CFEE.note: where LoadSkillRecord puts the 17 bytes of a skill record (byte 2 of the buffer)

CFE6.name: wMonsterId
CFE6.note: 16-bit monster id (wCFE7 is the high byte) that LoadMonsterRecord reads

D081.name: wItemId
D081.note: item id used by LoadItemRecord and RunItemEffect; $FF = none

C61D.name: wInventory
C61D.note: 24-slot bag of item ids (searched by FindHFFC6InWC61DList; empty at the start of a new game)

FF90.name: hMapId
FF90.note: map number: indexes MapTable (bank $11); 29 on the opening ship deck; the map's name is the system string at index 10 + number ('Deck' for 29, 'NO' for the unused 30, 31, 39)

FF8F.name: hMapScreenX
FF8F.note: column of the current screen in the map: LoadMapScreen indexes the map's array of screen streams with hMapScreenY * width + hMapScreenX (1 on the opening ship deck, a map 2 screens wide)

FF92.name: hMapScreenY
FF92.note: row of the current screen in the map (0 on the opening ship deck)

C190.name: wMapWidthScreens
C190.note: map width in screens, from the map record (2 for the ship deck, 4 for map 56)

C191.name: wMapHeightScreens
C191.note: map height in screens, from the map record

C192.name: wMaxBlockingTile
C192.note: highest tile id that blocks the player (TileBlockedAtPixel compares tile ids with it); from the map record (55 for the ship deck)

C919.name: wScriptStartRequest
C919.note: bit 7 set asks FetchScriptCommand to begin running the script at wScriptPointer

C91A.name: wScriptPointerLo
C91A.note: low byte of the address of the next script byte (wC91B is the high byte; the bytes are in the current bank, or in wDataBank when wScriptInDataBank is set)

C91B.name: wScriptPointerHi
C91B.note: high byte of the script pointer

C7CC.name: wSpeciesFlags
C7CC.note: one bit per monster id (bit id & 7 of byte id / 8; TestSpeciesFlag, SetSpeciesFlag); counted per family by CountSpeciesPerFamilyFlaggedOrListed. What the bit records (for example a library entry) is not checked (E-0070)

C617.name: wGoldLo
C617.note: low byte of the 24-bit gold amount: the new-game setup sets 100 (InitGoldAndClearInventory), AddGoldCapped caps it at 99,999 and DrawGoldPanel_Bank24 shows it in decimal (E-0074)

C618.name: wGoldMid
C618.note: middle byte of the gold amount (E-0074)

C619.name: wGoldHi
C619.note: high byte of the gold amount (E-0074)

C920.name: wScriptCommandType
C920.note: the script command being run, 0 = none; indexes ScriptCommandHandlers (minus 1)

C921.name: wScriptParam0
C921.note: first parameter of the current script command

C922.name: wScriptParam1
C922.note: second parameter of the current script command

C923.name: wScriptStep
C923.note: step counter of the current script command

D7FD.name: wScriptInDataBank
D7FD.note: non-zero when the script bytes are read from the bank in wDataBank

D8BF.name: wBattleHP
D8BF.note: current HP of the 8 battle slots as 16-bit words (party in slots 0-2, a foe in slot 4); the first value of the party panels; a defeated foe's word fell from 20 to 0 on the emulator

D8CF.name: wBattleMaxHP
D8CF.note: maximum HP of the 8 battle slots (the foe's word stayed 25 when its current HP fell to 0)

D8DF.name: wBattleMP
D8DF.note: current MP of the 8 battle slots (the values the party panels show as M)

D8EF.name: wBattleMaxMP
D8EF.note: maximum MP of the 8 battle slots, by symmetry with wBattleMaxHP

CFC8.name: wBattlePhase
CFC8.note: battle phase, a 3-entry dispatch in Func_031_40CC: 1 = the fight, 2 = after the fight (victory message, rewards, recruiting); 0 at start (E-0044)

CFC9.name: wBattleStep
CFC9.note: step within the battle phase: in phase 1, 1 = set-up, 2 = command entry (a loop over the party), 3 = executing the chosen actions; in phase 2, 0-5 = the end-of-battle sequence (E-0044)

D8A4.name: wBattleActor
D8A4.note: slot number of the battler whose turn it is: indexes MP arrays and status records in the battle code

D8A5.name: wBattleTarget
D8A5.note: slot number of the battler an action is applied to (ApplyDamageToTarget, DefeatTarget)

DA63.name: wBattleSlotOut
DA63.note: one byte per slot: 1 when the battler is defeated or absent (DefeatTarget sets it; CarryUnlessWDA63SlotEmpty reads it)

DA1C.name: wBattleActionChoice
DA1C.note: word per slot: byte 0 is the chosen action id, which ChooseActionTarget copies to wBattleActionId; byte 1 is wBattleTargetChoice (E-0061)

DA1D.name: wBattleTargetChoice
DA1D.note: byte 1 of each slot word in wBattleActionChoice: the target slot the per-action target routines write (E-0061)

D0D5.name: wBattlerRecords
D0D5.note: six 78-byte ($4E) battler records for slots 0-2 and 4-6 (BattlerRecordFieldAddress); GetBaseHP reads the HP word at offset $1D (E-0062)

D7F9.name: wMenuInputResult
D7F9.note: result of the bank-$1B/$1D menu cursor routines: $FF confirmed (A), $FE cancelled (B), $FD row moved, $FB page moved, 0 nothing (E-0068)

D7FA.name: wTwoChoiceCursor
D7FA.note: 0 or 1, the selected entry of UpdateTwoChoiceCursor (E-0068)

D006.name: wSpeciesIdLo
D006.note: low byte of the monster id whose species record LoadSpeciesRecord loads (E-0069)

D007.name: wSpeciesIdHi
D007.note: high byte of that monster id (E-0069)

D008.name: wSpeciesRecord
D008.note: 47-byte copy of a species record (LoadSpeciesRecord); byte 0 is the family (E-0069)

D958.name: wBattleMonsterId
D958.note: word per battle slot: the monster id (the species-record and monster-name number; CopyMonsterNameOfWDAABSlotToDE, GetSlotSpeciesFamily) (E-0069)

C92C.name: wStepArrived
C92C.note: 1 when the last StepObjectTowardCoord or StepPlayer*TowardWC928 step reached the target coordinate in wC928, else 0 (E-0071)

DAAC.name: wQueuedActionId
DAAC.note: queued action id. One writer read so far stores $FF when a target's pending bit 4 (wD814 + 9 * target) is consumed (Func_036_4A38_Case04); banks $19 and $A0 also write it and are not read yet; read by QueuedActionMatches (E-0049)

D80C.name: wBattleStatus
D80C.note: 9-byte status record per slot (AddAx9ToHL), cleared when the battler is defeated

DAC4.name: wBattleStatResultLo
DAC4.note: low byte of the 16-bit result of the GetBase* routines (wDAC5 is the high byte)

D872.name: wBattleDamageLo
D872.note: low byte of the damage ApplyDamageToTarget subtracts (wD873 is the high byte)

DAC5.name: wBattleStatResultHi
DAC5.note: high byte of the 16-bit result of the GetBase* routines

CFCA.name: wBattleSubPhase
CFCA.note: index within the battle step: during step 3 of phase 1 it counts the actions being executed (0, 1, 2, ...); during command entry it alternates 1 and 2 (E-0044)

CFCB.name: wBattleResolveStep
CFCB.note: step of RunBattleResolveStep (16 cases, 0-15) for the action wBattleSubPhase is executing; ApplyDamageToTarget advances or rewinds it (E-0044)

CFCC.name: wBattleSubStep
CFCC.note: nested step used by Func_032_5EAB (10 cases) and cleared by ApplyDamageToTarget

CFCD.name: wBattleSubStep2
CFCD.note: nested step used by Func_032_5A3A (3 cases)

D8FF.name: wBattleATK
D8FF.note: attack of the 8 battle slots: ComputeBasicDamage reads the actor's word from it and the defence array for the target; 8 words, party in slots 0-2

D90F.name: wBattleDEF
D90F.note: defence of the 8 battle slots; RecomputeBattler (Func_032_5BE8) fills it from GetBaseDEF

D91F.name: wBattleAGL
D91F.note: agility of the 8 battle slots; Func_032_5BE8 fills it from GetBaseAGL

D92F.name: wBattleINT
D92F.note: intelligence of the 8 battle slots, the array after wBattleAGL (assumed)

D8A6.name: wBattleActionId
D8A6.note: id of the action being resolved; the resolve steps compare it with fixed values ($13-$15, $79, $91, $D6, $D7, $DC), some above the SkillTable range of 175, so it is an action number rather than a skill index
